overview: Delivery of production environments, connectors, access control, workflow and accepted operational runbooks. The scope is built around service SLOs, monitoring events and change procedures, producing runbooks, response rota, monthly reliability evidence and escalation. A customer-named service owner approves the work. The service-specific assurance focus is incident simulations and failover handoffs.
